name: Blend Method
definition: A volume rendering technique that resamples volume slices parallel to the final image plane into a frame buffer, shades samples on the CPU, writes shaded values back to the buffer, and uses graphics hardware blending (over operator) to composite the slices.
summary: The Blend Method is a texture-based volume rendering technique that offloads compositing to graphics hardware using the over operator, differing from the Planes method by leveraging hardware acceleration for faster processing of translucent volumes.
